description: Look up an Ink transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in ETH, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use ink_receipt, for emitted events ink_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x31e16195b9b6d9da5303988095e0dd5ee278693cb920de7d09fcee624c4f4733. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: ink_tx
title: Ink transaction
